scope: Accounting metadata only. No archived physical/model outputs inspected; no remote builds, paid invocations, downloads of Volume file contents, deployments, cancellations, deletions or budget changes.

provider_checks.inventory: modal environment list --json; modal app list --json and modal container list --json for BOTH returned environments; modal app info -e main --json on the two local allocation IDs and the third archive app ID from the provider report.
provider_checks.inventory_note: One unrelated deployed app in main; no live containers. A recent-app listing alone did not return the stopped archive apps. Each of the three historical IDs was looked up directly and was stopped.
provider_checks.meter: modal billing report --start 2026-11-24T00:00 --end 2026-11-24T14:00 --resolution h --show-resources --json (UTC, exclusive end); the 11:00-14:00 query returned the same seven archive rows. All seven are in the 12:00 UTC hour, environment main, description rsmi-archive-learning. Values below are reported gross, not estimated and not net invoices.
provider_checks.summary: modal billing summary --for 2026-11 --json: open-cycle workspace billed_cost was zero after adjustments at observation. No project-specific net invoice or final cycle invoice obtained. This is NOT evidence that the historical work was free or that future gross resource use is funded.
provider_checks.budget_inspection: Read-only workspace billing API exposes report/rates/summary, not a job-specific spend ceiling. Workspace settings list and the documented settings interface do not establish a dedicated gross dollar ceiling for this experiment. Environment budgets cover compute only. No shared workspace budget was modified.
provider_checks.storage_inspection: modal volume list -e main --json and modal volume ls -e main --json on the historical Volume root and its sole subdirectory; filename/type/byte-count metadata only.

historical_accounting.admission_hash_note: For each row admission_sha256 is identical for the old global ledger record and the scratch admission.json. Application IDs below are SHA-256 of the provider ID UTF-8 bytes without newline; these are not access credentials.
historical_accounting.old_policy: One 120 s input per admission, L4/L40S, hard 2 physical cores and 6144 MiB, 155 s queue + 130 s startup + 45 s teardown. The legacy runner reserved 450 * historical per-second rate + 0.20. The amount in its ledger is not itself a contractual maximum bill.

cells.join_basis: Inferred: no local allocation file; the remaining uniquely named/timed archive app was created 12:05:01Z just after this 12:05:00.747Z admission. The other two joins are exact allocation-ID joins.

historical_shared_volume.note: Logical bytes are not billed GiB-months. No retention deadline observed; snapshots daily, possible charges for up to four days after deletion. Kept intact; no new study data written to it.

tariff.costing_rule: Use exact account hourly rates / 3600 rather than rounded public seconds; no credits, free storage/egress, discounts, or region premiums assumed. Require base-price untargeted GPU Function, not Sandbox, no region pinning, no optional disk reservation, snapshots, replication or ancillary services.
tariff.billing_floor: Per second, no minimum usage-time increment. Billable application loading/idle time; cpu/memory metered at max(request, actual), minimum 0.125 physical cores/128 MiB. A 90 s Function timeout is not a 90 s invoice.
tariff.allowances_not_relied_on: Pricing page: Volume 1 TiB/month free; network allowance 1/10/100 TiB for Starter/Team/Enterprise shared per billing cycle, not dedicated to this job.
